page_title: CAM 3-3 SRB | Cameroon v Serbia 28/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Marko Grujic (Serbia) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
90+5' Georges-Kevin N'Koudou (Cameroon) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nikola Milenkovic (Serbia) was quite harsh and Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Filip Djuricic (Serbia) will replace Filip Kostic.
90+1' The game is interrupted as Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) is flagged offside.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) latches onto a decent pass, but flashes his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cameroon.
88' Filip Kostic (Serbia) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
87' Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
86' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Filip Kostic (Serbia).
85' Christian Bassogog (Cameroon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
83' A pass by Filip Kostic (Serbia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
82' Cameroon work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
81' Rigobert Song has decided to make a change. Georges-Kevin N'Koudou (Cameroon) replaces Bryan Mbeumo.
81' That will be all from Andre Zambo Anguissa who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Samuel Oum Gouet (Cameroon).
80' Nouhou Tolo (Cameroon) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
78' A substitution has been made. Sergej Milinkovic-Savic is replaced by Marko Grujic (Serbia).
78' Dragan Stojkovic decides to make a substitution. Andrija Zivkovic will be replaced by Nemanja Radonjic (Serbia).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Srdjan Babic (Serbia) comes onto the pitch for Milos Veljkovic.
78' Sergej Milinkovic-Savic (Serbia) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cameroon will have a goal kick.

77' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Devis Epassy anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
75' Gael Ondoua (Cameroon) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
73' Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed has a clear sight and sees a foul from Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon).
73' Filip Kostic (Serbia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
72' Rough tackle by Dusan Tadic (Serbia). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
69' Nikola Milenkovic (Serbia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed blows for a foul.
67' Rigobert Song has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gael Ondoua (Cameroon) replacing Pierre Kunde.
67' Substitution. Karl Toko Ekambi will be replaced by Christian Bassogog (Cameroon).
66' 3 - 3 Goal! Vincent Aboubakar passes the ball to the feet of Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Cameroon), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 3:3.

63' 2 - 3 GOAL - 2:3! Jean-Charles Castelletto found Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Vanja Milinkovic-Savic off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
63' Attention! Referee Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
63' Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) has a goal ruled out for offside!
62' Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert and denies him.
60' Bryan Mbeumo (Cameroon) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
60' Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
60' Filip Kostic (Serbia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dusan Tadic (Serbia) and blew his whistle.
57' Sergej Milinkovic-Savic (Serbia) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
57' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cameroon, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
56' Strahinja Pavlovic has picked up an injury and is replaced by Stefan Mitrovic (Serbia).
56' The game is interrupted now, Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
55' Rigobert Song prepares a substitution. Martin Hongla is replaced by Vincent Aboubakar (Cameroon).
55' Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' 1 - 3 Goal! Andrija Zivkovic feeds Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:3.
52' Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
52' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Bryan Mbeumo (Cameroon), but the defence gets it clear.
51' Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Flag up against Dusan Tadic (Serbia). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
49' Filip Kostic (Serbia) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
47' Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed blows his whistle. Dusan Tadic (Serbia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+8' Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45+7' Sasa Lukic (Serbia) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45+7' The corner from Dusan Tadic (Serbia) is intercepted by Devis Epassy.

45+6' This shall not pass! Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Serbia have been awarded a corner kick.
45+4' Although Luka Jovic (Serbia) is just on the bench, Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
45+3' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Sergej Milinkovic-Savic (Serbia) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Andrija Zivkovic provided an assist for the goal.
45+3' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

45+1' 1 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Dusan Tadic sends the ball in, Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a cracking header inside the left post. It's 1:1.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Martin Hongla (Cameroon) makes a rough challenge and Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed blows his whistle for a foul.

44' Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) looks furious with himself after spurning a great chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Serbia will have a goal kick.

44' Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot low into the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
41' Filip Kostic (Serbia) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
39' Filip Kostic (Serbia) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
39' Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
38' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
36' The ball possession is 41:59.
36' Collins Fai (Cameroon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
34' Collins Fai (Cameroon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Collins Fai (Cameroon) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
32' Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed blows his whistle and it's Dusan Tadic (Serbia) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
30' Having seen unsporting behavior, Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Christian Bassogog (Cameroon) is the recipient.
29' 1 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Jean-Charles Castelletto (Cameroon) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Nicolas N'Koulou knock down. 1:0.
28' There's an opportunity for Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
27' Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
26' It looks like Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) saw red with that tackle. Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
25' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) sends a lofted pass from the resulting free kick, but fails to hit the ball properly and his effort goes out of play.
24' Nicolas N'Koulou (Cameroon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed had an easy-decision to make.
23' The game is interrupted. Andre Zambo Anguissa (Cameroon) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
22' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Devis Epassy has no trouble gathering it.
21' Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
20' Collins Fai (Cameroon) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Cameroon take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

19' Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The ball is out of play. Cameroon win a corner kick.

17' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Cameroon will have a goal kick.
16' Nicolas N'Koulou (Cameroon) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Serbia.
16' Martin Hongla (Cameroon) is able to continue to play.
15' Nikola Milenkovic (Serbia) commits a rough challenge and Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Pierre Kunde (Cameroon) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
12' Martin Hongla (Cameroon) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' Filip Kostic (Serbia) was too forceful with his tackle and Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
11' Filip Kostic (Serbia) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Cameroon will have a goal kick.

11' OFF THE POST! Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
9' Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
9' The Serbia players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

6' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) is first to a cross from Nemanja Maksimovic and thunders in a great header at goal from near the penalty spot that flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cameroon.
5' Karl Toko Ekambi (Cameroon) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
2' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
1' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Serbia will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mohammed Abdulla Hassan Mohammed.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
